term: source-backed joint supply for actual concrete existence
definition: At least one actual concrete candidate has the existing inductive joint Supply on the recorded actual-concrete grounding graph, with its intrinsic predicate instantiated as sources of that same selected grounding relation. Records for non-source targets list all actual concrete immediate grounds and have nonempty contributors. This is an explicit existential-application/adequacy premise; it does not assert a necessary source or a well-founded whole graph.
note: Application of the already defined joint-supply standard to the existing actual-concrete subtype, not a new account of borrowing and not a historical source reading. Here the intrinsic predicate is expressly graph sourcehood for the selected existential-grounding relation, rather than intrinsic event power. Actual applicability and this source interpretation are OPEN; no event is silently identified with its bearer. Infinite contributor sets remain allowed. See the cumulative route at the beginning of docs/notes/ultimate-adequacy-integration-735.md. CONCRETE-SUPPLY-ROOT-EQUIVALENCE exposes that the existential Supply premise is equivalent to actual root existence. Its source can itself be the witness; do not count the application alone as an independent defense of roots. The separate cut premise supplies that justification conditionally.
